candidates.why: free.c:1323-1324 calls hash_free(dwg->object_map) but never sets dwg->object_map = NULL (only hash_free's internal hash->array is nulled, hash.c:191). A later dwg_add_handle on an obj whose parent is that freed Dwg_Data passes the `if (!dwg->object_map)` guard at dwg.c:1944 (pointer is non-NULL but dangling) and then hash_set() at dwg.c:1946 writes into freed memory.

dwg_add_handle dereferences obj->parent at dwg.c:1941 and uses it at 1946, but obj is a const pointer with no lifetime guarantee; if the caller passes an object belonging to a Dwg_Data already torn down by dwg_free (free.c:1240-1327), the parent pointer is dangling. No in-tree caller evidence, hence low.
